# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest published `1.x` release of
`@inandu-solutions/grid-angular`.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 1.x     | ✅        |
| < 1.0   | ❌        |

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security problems.**

Report privately via GitHub's ["Report a vulnerability"](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid/security/advisories/new)
form on the repository's Security tab. If that is unavailable to you, contact
Inandu SAS via <https://www.inandu.com/contact/> instead.

Please include:

- affected version(s),
- a description of the issue and its impact,
- a minimal proof of concept if you have one.

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few business days, agree on a disclosure
timeline with you, and credit you in the release notes unless you prefer to remain
anonymous.
